html:
D146　走完一次故障处置与关单

第 21 周 · 5 小时。前置阅读为 D145-用LangGraph对照流程分支。本章使用 Node.js 20、pnpm 10、NestJS 12 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

让同一张故障工单走完分诊、诊断、建议、审批、执行、复核和关单。每推进一步都从 HTTP 重新读进度；关单前故意漏一次复核，并用旧工单版本再试一次。在 apps/server 先运行 pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy 和 pnpm db:generate。

目录与时间

★ apps/server/prisma/migrations/20261119110000_incident_links/migration.sql
★ apps/server/src/agent/incident-workflow.controller.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/incident-workflow.service.ts
★ apps/server/test/incident-workflow.e2e-spec.ts
★ apps/server/prisma/schema.prisma
★ apps/server/src/agent/agent.module.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts

★ 为本章新建或修改的文件。闭卷 20 分钟，设计 45 分钟，端到端集成 110 分钟，跑基线与判读 75 分钟，提交 50 分钟。优先完成必做用例，超时先跳过拓展。工作日到 1 小时 40 分先停选做内容，留 20 分钟做必做自检。完整回归的等待时间另计。

零、闭卷回忆

D145　图中的 advance 可以在等待状态运行吗？

核对答案

inspect 只有在当前阶段已完成且仍有阶段时才进入 advance，等待与阻塞都结束本次调用。

D143　本次请求、长期偏好和默认谁优先？

核对答案

本次明确要求优先，然后才查询有效偏好，最后回到默认顺序。

D139　第 50 轮输入如何保住审批结论？

核对答案

后端从冻结任务和审批状态取事实，独立于滑动的历史窗口。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 绑定这一次故障处理

GET /api/agent/runs/:id/workflow 读取当前工单类别及优先级，按 P1/P2 或普通优先级分流。诊断终态和分类来自 run_finished；操作者再把同一运行中一笔待审改派绑定成建议。另一个运行的任务 ID 无法替代它。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/incident-workflow.e2e-spec.ts -t "从分诊到关单保留七步证据且重复恢复只改派一次"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/incident-workflow.e2e-spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('从分诊到关单保留七步证据且重复恢复只改派一次', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare(), run = flow.path.slice(0, -'/tasks'.length), url = run + '/workflow';
    const view = async () => (await f.api.get(url).set('authorization', f.auth).expect(200)).body.data;
    const post = (path: string, auth: string, data: object) => f.api.post(path).set('authorization', auth).send(data);
    const marks: string[] = [];
    const intake = await view();
    expect(intake.triage.priority).toBe(flow.ticket.priority);
    marks.push(intake.next);
    diagnosis();
    await post(run + '/diagnose', f.auth, {}).expect(200);
    const analyzed = await view();
    expect(analyzed.answer).toContain('storage');
    marks.push(analyzed.next);
    const task = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    await post(url + '/proposal', f.auth, { taskId: task.id }).expect(201);
    marks.push((await view()).next);
    const action = '/api/agent/tasks/' + task.id;
    await post(action + '/review', f.reviewAuth, { decision: 'approve', digest: task.digest }).expect(201);
    marks.push((await view()).next);
    const delivered = (await post(action + '/resume', f.auth, {}).expect(201)).body.data.receipt;
    expect((await post(action + '/resume', f.auth, {}).expect(201)).body.data.receipt).toEqual(delivered);
    marks.push((await view()).next);
    const resolved = (await post('/api/tickets/' + flow.ticket.ticketNo + '/transitions', f.login('alice'),
      { action: 'resolve', version: delivered.version, comment: '容量恢复，等待独立复核' }).expect(200)).body.data;
    const check = { observed: 'service-restored', version: resolved.version };
    const terms = { requestKey: randomUUID(), version: resolved.version, comment: '已核对恢复记录' };
    await post(run + '/close-requests', f.auth, terms).expect(409);
    await post(url + '/verification', f.auth, check).expect(403);
    await post(url + '/verification', f.reviewAuth, { ...check, version: delivered.version }).expect(409);
    await post(url + '/verification', f.reviewAuth, check).expect(201);
    marks.push((await view()).next);
    const close = (await post(run + '/close-requests', f.auth, terms).expect(201)).body.data;
    const closure = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + close.id;
    await post(closure + '/approve', f.reviewAuth, {}).expect(201);
    await post(closure + '/execute', f.auth, {}).expect(201);
    const last = await view();
    expect(last).toMatchObject({ status: 'done', completed: stages, next: null });
    expect(marks).toEqual(stages.slice(1));
    const events = await f.db.ticketEvent.findMany({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id } });
    const assignments = events.filter(e => e.type === 'assigned').length;
    const closures = events.filter(e => e.toStatus === 'closed').length;
    expect([assignments, closures]).toEqual([1, 1]);
    if (process.env.D146_EVIDENCE_FILE) appendFileSync(process.env.D146_EVIDENCE_FILE,
      JSON.stringify({ case: 'incident-seven', ticket: flow.ticket.ticketNo, taskId: task.id, stages: last.completed,
        category: analyzed.answer.split(' · ')[0], assignments, closures, verifiedVersion: resolved.version }) + '\n');
  });

推导题　为什么要同时核对运行、租户、工单和冻结版本？

答案

任务 ID 只负责定位。绑定时应确认它属于本次运行、本班组及工单，且动作尚待审、基于当前版本。否则另一笔建议的审批或回执可能被错算到本次流程。

1.2 让复核挡在关单写入前

批准并执行一次改派后，处理人把工单转为 resolved。指定的另一名复核人确认服务已恢复，并提交看见的工单版本。服务端核对实际回执、处理人及解决版本，提交关单申请与实际消费审批时都检查复核记录。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/incident-workflow.e2e-spec.ts -t "建议只能绑定本次诊断且拒绝审批后停住"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/incident-workflow.e2e-spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('建议只能绑定本次诊断且拒绝审批后停住', async () => {
    const f1 = await f.prepare(), f2 = await f.prepare();
    const run = f1.path.slice(0, -'/tasks'.length), url = run + '/workflow';
    const task = (await f1.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const other = (await f2.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const proposal = (taskId: string) => f.api.post(url + '/proposal').set('authorization', f.auth).send({ taskId });
    await proposal(task.id).expect(409);
    diagnosis();
    await f.api.post(run + '/diagnose').set('authorization', f.auth).send({}).expect(200);
    await proposal(other.id).expect(404);
    await proposal(task.id).expect(201);
    await proposal(task.id).expect(201);
    await f.api.get(url).set('authorization', f.login('bob')).expect(404);
    await f.api.post('/api/agent/tasks/' + task.id + '/review').set('authorization', f.reviewAuth)
      .send({ decision: 'reject', digest: task.digest }).expect(201);
    const view = (await f.api.get(url).set('authorization', f.auth).expect(200)).body.data;
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ next: 'approve', status: 'blocked' });
    expect(await f.db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: f1.ticket.id, type: 'assigned' } })).toBe(0);
  });

推导题　两个同事同时点恢复，复核人可用什么证明只做了一次？

答案

看同一冻结动作的回执、工单版本及工单事件。端到端用例重复提交恢复，比较回执及最终 assigned 事件数，不能用页面只提示一次作依据。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　沿公开接口取证

提示一 · 方向

从创建运行、执行诊断开始，每次 GET workflow。

提示二 · API

POST workflow/proposal、tasks/:id/review、tasks/:id/resume。

提示三 · 实现顺序

对照每一步的 next。先给别的运行的任务号，再用正确的任务号。

步骤 2　通过真实复核关单

提示一 · 方向

让改派后的处理人先解决工单，再由指定复核人确认。

提示二 · API

POST workflow/verification，随后调用 close-requests、approve、execute。

提示三 · 实现顺序

检查无复核 409、自审 403、旧版本 409，最后核对复核版本和唯一关单事件。

三、自检与提交

对照每一步的 next。先给别的运行的任务号，再用正确的任务号。 检查无复核 409、自审 403、旧版本 409，最后核对复核版本和唯一关单事件。 请保存所用的请求或输入、预期和实际输出。

复测模型时，在 apps/server 的 PowerShell 设置 $env:OPS_REAL_DIAGNOSIS="1"，运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/diagnosis.e2e-spec.ts -t 本机模型逐项评测，结束后执行 Remove-Item Env:OPS_REAL_DIAGNOSIS。本机需提供 tinyllama:latest。

反证 A　在 apps/server/src/agent/incident-workflow.service.ts 把 if (!diagnosed) throw new ConflictException 临时替为 if (diagnosed) throw new ConflictException，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

Error: expected 409 "Conflict", got 201 "Created"

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/src/agent/incident-workflow.service.ts 把 link.verifiedAt === null || link.verifiedVersion !== version 临时替为 link.verifiedAt !== null && link.verifiedVersion !== version，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

Error: expected 409 "Conflict", got 201 "Created"

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

三轮完整业务核查

每轮重建测试工单并生成新的持久任务 ID，夹具清理后可复用同一个展示工单号。通过 HTTP 运行真实业务处理与数据库事务。此处模型分类使用可控响应，下面的十题对照另外调用本机模型。

四、本章完整源码

下列文件按当天验证工程快照生成。

apps/server/src/agent/incident-workflow.controller.ts

import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Get, Param, ParseUUIDPipe, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { RequirePermission } from '../auth/permissions.decorator.js';
import { CurrentUser } from '../common/current-user.decorator.js';
import { IncidentWorkflowService, verificationVersion } from './incident-workflow.service.js';

@Controller('agent/runs/:id/workflow')
@RequirePermission('ticket:read')
export class IncidentWorkflowController {
  constructor(private readonly flow: IncidentWorkflowService) {}
  @Get()
  view(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string) { return this.flow.view(user.id, id); }
  @Post('proposal')
  propose(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    const body = z.object({ taskId: z.uuid() }).strict().safeParse(input);
    if (!body.success) throw new BadRequestException('需要原动作编号');
    return this.flow.propose(user.id, id, body.data.taskId);
  }
  @Post('verification')
  verify(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    return this.flow.verify(user.id, id, verificationVersion(input));
  }
}

apps/server/src/agent/incident-workflow.service.ts

import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, ForbiddenException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { readAccess } from '../assistant/read-tools.service.js';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import { effectiveState } from './durable-tasks.service.js';
import { incidentPlan } from './incident-plan.js';

const resolution = z.object({ action: z.literal('reassign'), ticketNo: z.string(), version: z.number().int(), assigneeId: z.uuid() });
const finish = z.object({ answer: z.string().regex(/^(network|storage|power|unknown) · .+/) });

export async function requireIncidentReview(tx: TransactionClient, runId: string, version: number) {
  const link = await tx.incidentLink.findUnique({ where: { runId } });
  if (link && (link.verifiedAt === null || link.verifiedVersion !== version)) throw new ConflictException('需要复核当前工单版本');
}

@Injectable()
export class IncidentWorkflowService {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService) {}
  private async snapshot(tx: TransactionClient, actor: string, runId: string) {
    const { user, fingerprint } = await readAccess(tx, actor).catch((err: unknown) => {
      if (err instanceof Error && err.message === 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN') throw new ForbiddenException();
      throw err;
    });
    if (!user.tenantKey) throw new ForbiddenException();
    const run = await tx.agentRun.findFirst({ where: { id: runId, tenantKey: user.tenantKey } });
    if (!run) throw new NotFoundException();
    const link = await tx.incidentLink.findUnique({ where: { runId }, include: { task: true } });
    if (run.userId !== actor && link?.task.reviewerId !== actor) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (run.userId === actor && run.scopeHash !== fingerprint) throw new ForbiddenException();
    if (actor !== run.userId && (!user.permissions?.includes('agent:review-operation') || !user.permissions.includes('ticket:assign'))) throw new ForbiddenException();
    const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({ where: { ticketNo: run.ticketNo, ...agentScope(user) }, select: { ticketNo: true, priority: true, category: true, groupId: true, status: true, version: true, assigneeId: true } });
    if (!ticket || (link && ticket.groupId !== link.task.groupId)) throw new NotFoundException();
    const ev = await tx.agentEvent.findFirst({ where: { runId, type: 'run_finished' }, orderBy: { seq: 'desc' } });
    const answer = finish.safeParse(ev?.payload);
    const diagnosed = run.status === 'succeeded' && run.stopReason === 'answered' && answer.success;
    return { run, ticket, link, diagnosed, answer: diagnosed ? answer.data.answer : null };
  }

  async propose(actor: string, runId: string, taskId: string) {
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const { run, ticket, link, diagnosed } = await this.snapshot(tx, actor, runId);
      if (run.userId !== actor) throw new ForbiddenException();
      if (link && link.taskId !== taskId) throw new ConflictException('该运行已绑定其他动作');
      if (link) return { taskId };
      if (!diagnosed) throw new ConflictException('请先完成诊断');
      const task = await tx.durableTask.findFirst({ where: { id: taskId, runId, ownerId: actor, groupId: ticket.groupId,
        ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, tenantKey: run.tenantKey } });
      if (!task) throw new NotFoundException();
      const cmd = z.object({ action: z.literal('reassign'), version: z.number().int() }).safeParse(task.command);
      if (effectiveState(task) !== 'waiting' || !cmd.success || cmd.data.version !== ticket.version) throw new ConflictException('需要当前版本的待审改派');
      const inserted = await tx.incidentLink.createMany({ data: { runId, taskId }, skipDuplicates: true });
      if (!inserted.count && (await tx.incidentLink.findUnique({ where: { runId } }))?.taskId !== taskId) throw new ConflictException('建议发生冲突');
      return { taskId };
    });
  }

  async verify(actor: string, runId: string, version: number) {
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const { run, ticket, link } = await this.snapshot(tx, actor, runId);
      if (!link || actor === run.userId || actor !== link.task.reviewerId) throw new ForbiddenException();
      const receipt = resolution.safeParse(link.task.receipt);
      if (ticket.status !== 'resolved' || ticket.version !== version || link.task.state !== 'completed' ||
        link.task.approvedDigest !== link.task.digest || !receipt.success || receipt.data.ticketNo !== ticket.ticketNo ||
        receipt.data.version + 1 !== version || receipt.data.assigneeId !== ticket.assigneeId) throw new ConflictException('业务回执与当前解决版本不符');
      if (link.verifiedAt && link.verifiedVersion !== version) throw new ConflictException('复核版本已变化');
      if (!link.verifiedAt) await tx.incidentLink.update({ where: { runId }, data: { verifiedAt: new Date(), verifiedBy: actor, verifiedVersion: version } });
      return { verifiedVersion: version };
    });
  }

  async view(actor: string, runId: string) {
    return this.db.$transaction(async tx => {
      const { run, ticket, link, diagnosed, answer } = await this.snapshot(tx, actor, runId);
      const task = link?.task;
      const receipt = resolution.safeParse(task?.receipt);
      const closed = !!link?.verifiedAt && ticket.status === 'closed' && ticket.version === link.verifiedVersion! + 1 &&
        !!await tx.closeApproval.findFirst({ where: { runId, ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, tenantKey: run.tenantKey,
          requesterId: run.userId, state: 'executed', version: link.verifiedVersion! } });
      const verified = !!link?.verifiedAt && (closed || ticket.status === 'resolved' && link.verifiedVersion === ticket.version);
      const triage = { category: ticket.category, priority: ticket.priority,
        queue: ['P1', 'P2'].includes(ticket.priority) ? 'priority' : 'standard' };
      return { ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, triage, answer, taskId: task?.id ?? null, ...incidentPlan({
        diagnosed, diagnosisFailed: ['failed','cancelled','succeeded'].includes(run.status) && !diagnosed, proposed: !!link,
        taskState: task ? effectiveState(task) : null, approved: !!task && task.approvedDigest === task.digest,
        delivered: task?.state === 'completed' && receipt.success && receipt.data.ticketNo === ticket.ticketNo,
        verified, closed }) };
    }, { isolationLevel: 'RepeatableRead' });
  }
}

export function verificationVersion(input: unknown) {
  const parsed = z.object({ observed: z.literal('service-restored'), version: z.number().int().min(0) }).strict().safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new BadRequestException('请确认观测结果及工单版本');
  return parsed.data.version;
}

apps/server/test/incident-workflow.e2e-spec.ts

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { ModelGateway } from '../src/assistant/model-gateway.js';
import { stages } from '../src/agent/incident-plan.js';
import { durableFixtures } from './durable-fixtures.js';

describe('一次故障的七步工作流', () => {
  let f: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof durableFixtures>>;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    vi.stubEnv('DURABLE_WORKER_MS', '0');
    f = await durableFixtures('WFL');
  });
  afterEach(() => { vi.restoreAllMocks(); });
  afterAll(async () => { try { await f.close(); } finally { vi.unstubAllEnvs(); } });
  function diagnosis() {
    return vi.spyOn(f.app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"category":"storage"}' } }],
    });
  }

  it('从分诊到关单保留七步证据且重复恢复只改派一次', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare(), run = flow.path.slice(0, -'/tasks'.length), url = run + '/workflow';
    const view = async () => (await f.api.get(url).set('authorization', f.auth).expect(200)).body.data;
    const post = (path: string, auth: string, data: object) => f.api.post(path).set('authorization', auth).send(data);
    const marks: string[] = [];
    const intake = await view();
    expect(intake.triage.priority).toBe(flow.ticket.priority);
    marks.push(intake.next);
    diagnosis();
    await post(run + '/diagnose', f.auth, {}).expect(200);
    const analyzed = await view();
    expect(analyzed.answer).toContain('storage');
    marks.push(analyzed.next);
    const task = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    await post(url + '/proposal', f.auth, { taskId: task.id }).expect(201);
    marks.push((await view()).next);
    const action = '/api/agent/tasks/' + task.id;
    await post(action + '/review', f.reviewAuth, { decision: 'approve', digest: task.digest }).expect(201);
    marks.push((await view()).next);
    const delivered = (await post(action + '/resume', f.auth, {}).expect(201)).body.data.receipt;
    expect((await post(action + '/resume', f.auth, {}).expect(201)).body.data.receipt).toEqual(delivered);
    marks.push((await view()).next);
    const resolved = (await post('/api/tickets/' + flow.ticket.ticketNo + '/transitions', f.login('alice'),
      { action: 'resolve', version: delivered.version, comment: '容量恢复，等待独立复核' }).expect(200)).body.data;
    const check = { observed: 'service-restored', version: resolved.version };
    const terms = { requestKey: randomUUID(), version: resolved.version, comment: '已核对恢复记录' };
    await post(run + '/close-requests', f.auth, terms).expect(409);
    await post(url + '/verification', f.auth, check).expect(403);
    await post(url + '/verification', f.reviewAuth, { ...check, version: delivered.version }).expect(409);
    await post(url + '/verification', f.reviewAuth, check).expect(201);
    marks.push((await view()).next);
    const close = (await post(run + '/close-requests', f.auth, terms).expect(201)).body.data;
    const closure = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + close.id;
    await post(closure + '/approve', f.reviewAuth, {}).expect(201);
    await post(closure + '/execute', f.auth, {}).expect(201);
    const last = await view();
    expect(last).toMatchObject({ status: 'done', completed: stages, next: null });
    expect(marks).toEqual(stages.slice(1));
    const events = await f.db.ticketEvent.findMany({ where: { ticketId: flow.ticket.id } });
    const assignments = events.filter(e => e.type === 'assigned').length;
    const closures = events.filter(e => e.toStatus === 'closed').length;
    expect([assignments, closures]).toEqual([1, 1]);
    if (process.env.D146_EVIDENCE_FILE) appendFileSync(process.env.D146_EVIDENCE_FILE,
      JSON.stringify({ case: 'incident-seven', ticket: flow.ticket.ticketNo, taskId: task.id, stages: last.completed,
        category: analyzed.answer.split(' · ')[0], assignments, closures, verifiedVersion: resolved.version }) + '\n');
  });

  it('建议只能绑定本次诊断且拒绝审批后停住', async () => {
    const f1 = await f.prepare(), f2 = await f.prepare();
    const run = f1.path.slice(0, -'/tasks'.length), url = run + '/workflow';
    const task = (await f1.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const other = (await f2.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const proposal = (taskId: string) => f.api.post(url + '/proposal').set('authorization', f.auth).send({ taskId });
    await proposal(task.id).expect(409);
    diagnosis();
    await f.api.post(run + '/diagnose').set('authorization', f.auth).send({}).expect(200);
    await proposal(other.id).expect(404);
    await proposal(task.id).expect(201);
    await proposal(task.id).expect(201);
    await f.api.get(url).set('authorization', f.login('bob')).expect(404);
    await f.api.post('/api/agent/tasks/' + task.id + '/review').set('authorization', f.reviewAuth)
      .send({ decision: 'reject', digest: task.digest }).expect(201);
    const view = (await f.api.get(url).set('authorization', f.auth).expect(200)).body.data;
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ next: 'approve', status: 'blocked' });
    expect(await f.db.ticketEvent.count({ where: { ticketId: f1.ticket.id, type: 'assigned' } })).toBe(0);
  });
});

apps/server/prisma/schema.prisma

// 工单系统数据模型，对应 docs/data-model.md
// 状态、优先级等取值限制和跨字段规则 Prisma schema 表达不了，写在迁移 SQL 的 CHECK 约束里

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../src/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model User {
  tenantKey String @default("legacy") @map("tenant_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  id           String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  username     String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  displayName  String   @map("display_name") @db.VarChar(64)
  // 密码的 scrypt 哈希，格式见 src/auth/password.ts；为空表示这个账号不能登录（D15）
  passwordHash String?  @map("password_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  // 所属班组（D17）；系统账号、跨班组的管理人员可以没有班组
  groupId      String?  @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  // 手机号（D19）：敏感字段，没有 contact:read 权限的人看到的是脱敏后的 138****0001
  phone        String?  @db.VarChar(20)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  group     Group?     @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  roles     UserRole[]
  auditLogs AuditLog[]

  preferences AgentPreference[]
  toolNotes AgentToolNote[]
  reportedTickets Ticket[]      @relation("TicketReporter")
  assignedTickets Ticket[]      @relation("TicketAssignee")
  ticketEvents    TicketEvent[]
  notifications   Notification[]
  aiQuotas        AiQuota[]
  aiConversations AiConversation[]

  @@map("users")
  agentRuns AgentRun[]
}

model Device {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String   @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String   @db.VarChar(128)
  type      String   @db.VarChar(32)
  location  String?  @db.VarChar(128)
  // 设备归哪个班组维护；告警自动建的工单归这个班组（D17）
  groupId   String   @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  group   Group    @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  tickets Ticket[]
  alerts  Alert[]

  @@map("devices")
}

model Ticket {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  ticketNo    String    @unique @map("ticket_no") @db.VarChar(20)
  title       String    @db.VarChar(200)
  description String    @default("")
  category    String    @default("other") @db.VarChar(16)
  creationKey String?   @map("creation_key") @db.Uuid
  creationHash String?  @map("creation_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  status      String    @default("pending") @db.VarChar(16)
  priority    String    @default("P3") @db.VarChar(2)
  deviceId    String?   @map("device_id") @db.Uuid
  reporterId  String    @map("reporter_id") @db.Uuid
  assigneeId  String?   @map("assignee_id") @db.Uuid
  // 工单归属的班组：只有这个班组的人能看、能处理（D17 行级权限）
  groupId     String    @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  version     Int       @default(0)
  slaDueAt    DateTime  @map("sla_due_at") @db.Timestamptz
  resolvedAt  DateTime? @map("resolved_at") @db.Timestamptz
  closedAt    DateTime? @map("closed_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // SLA 超时扫描（D25）发出超时通知的时间；为空表示还没通知过。条件更新它，保证每张工单只通知一次
  slaBreachedAt DateTime? @map("sla_breached_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // 超时满 30 分钟仍待处理时升级一次；和升级事件在同一事务里写入（D32）
  slaEscalatedAt DateTime? @map("sla_escalated_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // @updatedAt 由 Prisma Client 在每次更新时填写，绕过 Prisma 的写入不会刷新它
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  device   Device? @relation(fields: [deviceId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  reporter User    @relation("TicketReporter", fields: [reporterId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  assignee User?   @relation("TicketAssignee", fields: [assigneeId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  group    Group   @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  toolNotes AgentToolNote[]
  alerts Alert[]
  events TicketEvent[]

  // 工作台列表：按状态筛选、按创建时间倒序；末尾加 id，和排序完全一致，游标分页也能直接用（D5）
  @@index([status, createdAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "tickets_status_created_at_id_idx")
  // 班组的工作台列表：班组是等值条件，放在最前面（D4：等值条件在前、排序列在后）（D17）
  @@index([groupId, status, createdAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "tickets_group_status_created_at_id_idx")
  // 我的工单：按处理人和状态筛选
  @@index([assigneeId, status], map: "tickets_assignee_status_idx")
  @@unique([reporterId, creationKey], map: "tickets_reporter_creation_unique")
  @@map("tickets")
}

model Alert {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  deviceId   String   @map("device_id") @db.Uuid
  ticketId   String?  @map("ticket_id") @db.Uuid
  source     String   @db.VarChar(32)
  dedupKey   String   @map("dedup_key") @db.VarChar(128)
  severity   String   @db.VarChar(16)
  message    String
  occurredAt DateTime @map("occurred_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  device Device  @relation(fields: [deviceId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  ticket Ticket? @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  // 同一来源的同一告警只保留一条
  @@unique([source, dedupKey], map: "alerts_source_dedup_key_unique")
  // 工单详情统计合并的告警数量
  @@index([ticketId], map: "alerts_ticket_id_idx")
  // 设备的告警列表：按发生时间倒序，游标分页（D7 变式练习）
  @@index([deviceId, occurredAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "alerts_device_occurred_at_id_idx")
  @@map("alerts")
}

model TicketEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  ticketId   String   @map("ticket_id") @db.Uuid
  actorId    String   @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  type       String   @db.VarChar(16)
  fromStatus String?  @map("from_status") @db.VarChar(16)
  toStatus   String?  @map("to_status") @db.VarChar(16)
  content    String   @default("")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  ticket Ticket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  actor  User   @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  // 工单详情按时间列出处理记录
  @@index([ticketId, createdAt], map: "ticket_events_ticket_id_created_at_idx")
  @@map("ticket_events")
}

// ---------- 角色与权限（D16） ----------
// 权限点的取值见 packages/shared/src/permissions.ts；角色和“角色有哪些权限”是数据，由种子写入

model Role {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String   @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String   @db.VarChar(64)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  permissions RolePermission[]
  users       UserRole[]

  @@map("roles")
}

model Permission {
  id          String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code        String @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  description String @db.VarChar(200)

  roles RolePermission[]

  @@map("permissions")
}

// 关联表：删除角色或权限时，关联行跟着删（Cascade）。
// 这是对“外键一律 RESTRICT”（D1）的有意例外：关联行不是业务历史，留着没有意义
model RolePermission {
  roleId       String @map("role_id") @db.Uuid
  permissionId String @map("permission_id") @db.Uuid

  role       Role       @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  permission Permission @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([roleId, permissionId])
  // 主键以 role_id 开头，按权限查角色要单独的索引
  @@index([permissionId], map: "role_permissions_permission_id_idx")
  @@map("role_permissions")
}

model UserRole {
  userId    String   @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  roleId    String   @map("role_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role Role @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([userId, roleId])
  @@index([roleId], map: "user_roles_role_id_idx")
  @@map("user_roles")
}

// ---------- 班组（D17） ----------
model Group {
  tenantKey String @default("legacy") @map("tenant_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  id        String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String   @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String   @db.VarChar(64)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  users   User[]
  devices Device[]
  tickets Ticket[]

  manuals RetrievalManual[]
  @@map("groups")
}

// 运维手册的权威原文。停用后读侧即时拒绝引用。
model RetrievalManual {
  id      String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  groupId String @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  title   String @db.VarChar(200)
  body    String
  active  Boolean @default(true)
  group   Group @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@map("retrieval_manuals")
}

// ---------- 操作审计（D18） ----------
// 只追加、不修改、不删除：迁移里用触发器在数据库层拒绝 UPDATE、DELETE、TRUNCATE
model AuditLog {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  occurredAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("occurred_at") @db.Timestamptz
  actorId       String   @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  // 操作时的用户名快照：以后用户改名，审计里仍是当时的名字
  actorUsername String   @map("actor_username") @db.VarChar(64)
  // 做了什么，例如 ticket.transition、ticket.batch_assign
  action        String   @db.VarChar(64)
  entityType    String   @map("entity_type") @db.VarChar(32)
  // 业务上的标识（工单编号、设备编码），不用外键：被审计的数据删了，审计也要留着
  entityKey     String   @map("entity_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  before        Json?
  after         Json?
  // 同一个请求产生的审计、日志用它串起来
  requestId     String?  @map("request_id") @db.VarChar(64)

  actor User @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  // 按工单查审计时间线
  @@index([entityType, entityKey, occurredAt], map: "audit_logs_entity_idx")
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

// Outbox（D31）：业务事务里顺手写一行“要发出去的事件”，和业务数据一起提交或一起回滚
// 投递器（OutboxRelay）再把还没投递的行放进队列，放进去以后填上 published_at
model OutboxEvent {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  // ticket.assigned、ticket.sla_breached、ticket.sla_escalated
  type        String    @db.VarChar(64)
  payload     Json
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // 放进队列的时间；为空表示还没投递
  publishedAt DateTime? @map("published_at") @db.Timestamptz

  // 投递器每次按创建时间取还没投递的
  @@index([publishedAt, createdAt], map: "outbox_events_unpublished_idx")
  @@map("outbox_events")
}

// 站内通知（D31）：通知 Worker 根据 Outbox 事件生成，D33 推到页面上
model Notification {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  // D33：SSE 的持久游标。写入入口先锁用户，再分配序号并提交，避免同一用户提交乱序。
  streamSeq BigInt    @unique @default(autoincrement()) @map("stream_seq")
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  type      String    @db.VarChar(64)
  title     String    @db.VarChar(200)
  ticketNo  String?   @map("ticket_no") @db.VarChar(20)
  // 来自哪个 Outbox 事件：同一个事件给同一个人只生成一条通知，任务重做多少次都一样（D30 的消费者幂等）
  eventId   String    @map("event_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  readAt    DateTime? @map("read_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@unique([eventId, userId], map: "notifications_event_user_unique")
  // 查“我的通知”，按时间倒序
  @@index([userId, createdAt], map: "notifications_user_created_idx")
  @@index([userId, streamSeq], map: "notifications_user_stream_idx")
  @@map("notifications")
}

// D61：日额度与生成用量；不删除历史，待结算预留不会自动退款。
model AiQuota {
  userId String @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  period String @db.VarChar(10)
  available Int @default(200000)
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  usages AiUsage[]
  @@id([userId, period])
  @@map("ai_quotas")
}

model AiUsage {
  id String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  userId String @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  period String @db.VarChar(10)
  requestKey String @map("request_key") @db.Uuid
  reserved Int
  charged Int?
  status String @default("pending") @db.VarChar(16)
  inputTokens Int? @map("input_tokens")
  outputTokens Int? @map("output_tokens")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  settledAt DateTime? @map("settled_at") @db.Timestamptz
  quota AiQuota @relation(fields: [userId, period], references: [userId, period], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([userId, requestKey], map: "ai_usage_user_request_unique")
  @@index([userId, period])
  @@map("ai_usage")
}

// D66：会话与原始轮次只追加；终态不可通过服务重复改写。
model AiConversation {
  id String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  userId String @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  scopeHash String @map("scope_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  title String @db.VarChar(200)
  version Int @default(0)
  activeTurnId String? @map("active_turn_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  turns AiChatTurn[]
  @@index([userId, updatedAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@map("ai_conversations")
}

model AiChatTurn {
  id String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  conversationId String @map("conversation_id") @db.Uuid
  requestKey String @map("request_key") @db.Uuid
  ordinal Int
  question String @db.VarChar(2000)
  status String @default("running") @db.VarChar(16)
  mode String? @db.VarChar(8)
  transcript Json @default("[]")
  answer String @default("")
  errorCode String? @map("error_code") @db.VarChar(64)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  endedAt DateTime? @map("ended_at") @db.Timestamptz
  conversation AiConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([conversationId, requestKey])
  @@unique([conversationId, ordinal])
  @@map("ai_chat_turns")
}

model AgentRun {
  tenantKey String @default("legacy") @map("tenant_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  id String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  userId String @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  requestKey String @map("request_key") @db.Uuid
  ticketNo String @map("ticket_no") @db.VarChar(32)
  goal String @db.VarChar(500)
  scopeHash String @map("scope_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  status String @default("queued") @db.VarChar(16)
  stopReason String? @map("stop_reason") @db.VarChar(32)
  version Int @default(0)
  stepCount Int @default(0) @map("step_count")
  eventSeq Int @default(0) @map("event_seq")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  startedAt DateTime? @map("started_at") @db.Timestamptz
  endedAt DateTime? @map("ended_at") @db.Timestamptz
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  steps AgentStep[]
  events AgentEvent[]
  traces AgentTrace[]
  contexts AgentContextPacket[]
  incident IncidentLink?
  @@unique([userId, requestKey])
  @@index([userId, createdAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@map("agent_runs")
}

model AgentStep {
  id String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  runId String @map("run_id") @db.Uuid
  ordinal Int
  phase String @db.VarChar(16)
  status String @default("running") @db.VarChar(16)
  summary String @default("") @db.VarChar(500)
  errorCode String? @map("error_code") @db.VarChar(64)
  startedAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("started_at") @db.Timestamptz
  endedAt DateTime? @map("ended_at") @db.Timestamptz
  run AgentRun @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trace AgentTrace?
  events AgentEvent[]
  @@unique([runId, ordinal])
  @@map("agent_steps")
}

model AgentEvent {
  id String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  runId String @map("run_id") @db.Uuid
  stepId String? @map("step_id") @db.Uuid
  seq Int
  type String @db.VarChar(32)
  payload Json @default("{}")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  run AgentRun @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  step AgentStep? @relation(fields: [stepId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([runId, seq])
  @@index([runId, seq])
  @@map("agent_events")
}

model AgentTrace {
  id String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  runId String @map("run_id") @db.Uuid
  stepId String @unique @map("step_id") @db.Uuid
  ordinal Int
  kind String @db.VarChar(16)
  input String @db.VarChar(2000)
  output String @db.VarChar(2000)
  inputTokens Int @default(0) @map("input_tokens")
  outputTokens Int @default(0) @map("output_tokens")
  durationMs Int @default(0) @map("duration_ms")
  truncated Boolean @default(false)
  requestId String? @map("request_id") @db.VarChar(64)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  run AgentRun @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

import { requireIncidentReview } from './incident-workflow.service.js';
import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, ForbiddenException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { readAccess } from '../assistant/read-tools.service.js';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service.js';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { TicketsService } from '../tickets/tickets.service.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import { decideTool } from './agent-permission.js';

const terms = z.object({ requestKey: z.uuid(), version: z.number().int().min(0), comment: z.string().trim().min(1).max(500) }).strict();
export async function authorizedTarget(tx: TransactionClient, actor: string, ticketNo: string, tenantKey: string, review = false) {
  const { user } = await readAccess(tx, actor).catch((error: unknown) => {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN') throw new ForbiddenException();
    throw error;
  });
  if (user.tenantKey !== tenantKey) throw new NotFoundException();
  if (decideTool(user.permissions ?? [], 'closure', 'close_ticket') !== 'approval' ||
    (review && !user.permissions?.includes('ticket:approve-close'))) throw new ForbiddenException();
  const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({ where: { ...agentScope(user), ticketNo }, select: { version: true, status: true } });
  if (!ticket) throw new NotFoundException();
  return { user, ticket };
}

@Injectable()
export class CloseApprovalService {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly audit: AuditService, private readonly tickets: TicketsService) {}

  async submit(actor: string, runId: string, input: unknown) {
    const parsed = terms.safeParse(input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new BadRequestException('关单申请参数无效');
    const { requestKey, version, comment } = parsed.data;
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const run = await tx.agentRun.findFirst({ where: { id: runId, userId: actor } });
      if (!run) throw new NotFoundException();
      const { user, ticket } = await authorizedTarget(tx, actor, run.ticketNo, run.tenantKey);
      await requireIncidentReview(tx, runId, version);
      const data = { runId, requesterId: actor, requestKey, tenantKey: run.tenantKey,
        ticketNo: run.ticketNo, version, comment, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 600_000) };
      const previous = await tx.closeApproval.findUnique({ where: { runId_requestKey: { runId, requestKey } } });
      if (previous) {
        if (previous.version !== version || previous.comment !== comment) throw new ConflictException('请求键已用于其他参数');
        return previous;
      }
      if (ticket.version !== version || ticket.status !== 'resolved') throw new ConflictException('工单状态或版本已变化');
      const inserted = await tx.closeApproval.createMany({ data, skipDuplicates: true });
      const row = await tx.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { runId_requestKey: { runId, requestKey } } });
      if (row.version !== version || row.comment !== comment) throw new ConflictException('请求键已用于其他参数');
      if (inserted.count) await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.close_requested',
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: run.ticketNo, after: { approvalId: row.id, version } });
      return row;
    });
  }

  async execute(actor: string, id: string) {
    // 外层只取不可变参数；权限、版本、过期和单次消费在业务事务中重新检查。
    const row = await this.db.closeApproval.findFirst({ where: { id, requesterId: actor } });
    if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
    const owner = await this.db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: actor }, select: { username: true } });
    // 工单主键来自冻结快照，实际可见性在回调内按最新账号和班组复核。
    return this.tickets.transition(row.ticketNo, { action: 'close', version: row.version, comment: row.comment },
      owner.username, {}, async (tx, actorId) => {
        if (actorId !== actor) throw new ForbiddenException();
        await requireIncidentReview(tx, row.runId, row.version);
        const current = await tx.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
        if (current.state !== 'approved' || !current.reviewerId || current.reviewerId === actor) throw new ConflictException('需要有效审批');
        const { user } = await authorizedTarget(tx, actor, row.ticketNo, row.tenantKey);
        await authorizedTarget(tx, current.reviewerId, row.ticketNo, row.tenantKey, true);
        const changed = await tx.closeApproval.updateMany({ where: { id, state: 'approved', expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
          data: { state: 'executed' } });
        if (!changed.count) throw new ConflictException('审批已失效');
        await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.close_executed',
          entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { approvalId: id, reviewerId: current.reviewerId, version: row.version } });
        return agentScope(user);
      });
  }

  async review(actor: string, id: string, approve = false) {
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const row = await tx.closeApproval.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
      const { user, ticket } = await authorizedTarget(tx, actor, row.ticketNo, row.tenantKey, true);
      if (row.requesterId === actor) throw new ForbiddenException('需要另一位审批人');
      if (!approve) return row;
      if (ticket.version !== row.version || ticket.status !== 'resolved') throw new ConflictException('需要重新申请');
      const change = await tx.closeApproval.updateMany({ where: { id, state: 'pending', expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
        data: { state: 'approved', reviewerId: actor } });
      if (!change.count) throw new ConflictException('申请已过期或已处理');
      await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.close_approved',
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { approvalId: id, version: row.version } });
      return { ...row, reviewerId: actor, state: 'approved' };
    });
  }
}
